## Reading the Commercial Aerospace Monitor

China's commercial aerospace sector is driven by twin catalysts: SSE STAR Market IPO filings (LandSpace #2174, CAS Space #2180) and satellite constellation deployment (Qianfan G60, Jilin-1). Guowang (SatNet) Celestrak identifiers remain unresolved and are tracked as a documented data gap. This monitor tracks regulatory filings, launch cadence, constellation counts, and HK-listed supply-chain tickers. No stock recommendation is produced.
